textbookBox.concept: Factories grew in Manchester and other towns. Workers faced long hours, low wages and unemployment, and women and children were employed.

beats.en: Factories grew in Manchester and other towns. Workers faced long hours, low wages and unemployment, and women and children were employed.

beats.en: India's textile exports to Europe fell as Manchester cloth entered Indian markets. Weavers faced competition and the East India Company's control.
